_about: Snapshot of USGS geoserver WFS queries (wmadata:nhdflowline_network = NHDPlus V2) made by subrivers.py --refresh. names: per exact gnis_name, the WFS 1.1.0 hits count, the number of flowlines per VPU, and the COMIDs in the VPUs that subrivers.py searches. comid_attrs: [gnis_name, levelpathi, totdasqkm] per COMID ('' = blank name, null = COMID not in the layer). levelpath_names: GNIS name counts per level path.
